art_direction.identity: Kog'Maw is a squat four-legged Void creature with a heavy armored back, small bright eyes above a broad muzzle, short antenna-like projections, and a tapering tail. Preserve the low nonhuman chitin silhouette and natural species proportions, never an ordinary dog or human. Keep the mouth closed and composed, with no dripping acid, exposed teeth, bodily fluids, wounds, or frightening texture.
art_direction.scene: A gently elevated three-quarter arrangement, the signature motif nearest the viewer, modest accurate perspective and fresh reflected colors. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: olive, violet, pale sandstone, cool blue; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
